proposals.issue: Unverified owner can overwrite backup with arbitrary schema
proposals.suggestion: Require verified owner and a versioned, size-bounded backup envelope; assess restore compatibility and migration

proposals.issue: Legacy booking writes allowed when bookingMode document absent
proposals.suggestion: Require explicit legacy mode and migration evidence before any legacy write; test all Android upgrade paths

proposals.issue: Public business documents accessible when published
proposals.suggestion: Restrict published fields to intentionally public data and independently inspect current documents
